name: Minerva McGonagall
life: High-school physics teacher, Bogleheads forum regular. Invests a lump each quarter from her side tutoring income.
aesthetic: Minimalist. Wants allocation vs. target front and center, everything else hidden. Allergic to stock-picking features and gamification.
strategy: Three-fund portfolio 50% VTI / 30% VXUS / 20% BND. Each quarter she adds $6,000 to whatever is underweight. Never sells.
biases: dismissive of anything that isn't indexing
occasionally doubts international stocks after they lag
goals: see allocation drift vs. her 50/30/20 target
know where the next contribution should go
spend under 5 minutes a quarter in the app
